scenarios: The authored five-screen store preserves real walls, fixtures and all 42 reachable anchors
Manual movement uses swept small steps and cannot tunnel through a fixture or wall
Facing lock preserves avatar orientation while moving and interaction never rotates it
Paused world freezes player, monster, action, lure lifetime and clock together
Pickup and scatter require real proximity, clear ground, actual supply and their own elapsed action
F12 dynamically follows four actual player baits to the existing outdoor zone with two charges left
An initially closed but operable front door remains recoverable through a real half-second open
The slice refuses an inoperable only-declared exit instead of inventing a rear victory zone
Unbaited F12 chases only inside and cannot be won by simply walking outdoors
An intermediate outdoor lure can end without victory, return F12 inside, and still be recovered with two real replacement baits
Outdoor ground beyond the declared exit corridor cannot become a fake alternate victory route
The primary and backup boxes are finite same-shelf sources, not infinite refills
A full live-bait set rejects new placement without consuming another charge
F13 actual pickup, carry route and atomic store can prevent meat contact without sprint or a pet
F13 touching its real meat telegraphs, keeps the crate, and remains enraged after it is dropped
A cancelled F13 store retains the original carried crate and creates no delivery receipt
Freezer unavailable before admission rejects F13, and failure at commit never swallows the meat
Successful delivery is terminal despite later opening or outage and never pays twice
An actual chase hit has a visible windup, shared SAN delta and no task destruction
World motion emits actual walked distance and never drains passive resources or moves while paused
Serialized world continuation retains exact bait supply, actions, target and terminal receipts
scope: Deterministic authored-map F12/F13 physics and finite actions with moving enemies; no full-night director, all 60 monsters, dynamic multi-enemy combinations, production save system, mobile performance or WeChat runtime.
